column1: # mapping_set_title: 'CISA 2024 Framing Software Component Transparency <-> SPDX 3.0.1'

# mapping_set_description: 'Maps the 13 baseline attributes of Framing Software Component Transparency, 3rd Edition (CISA SBOM Tooling and Implementation Working Group, 2024): 5 SBOM metadata attributes (Author Name, Timestamp, SBOM Type, Primary Component, Dependency Relationship) and 8 component attributes (Component Name, Version, Supplier, Unique Identifier, Cryptographic Hash, Relationship, Concluded License, Copyright Notice) to properties, classes and RelationshipType individuals of the SPDX 3.0.1 model. Rows follow the bom-to-spdx30 rows of each bridge concept (bridge_concept column) and the ntia2021 / cisa2026 files for the attributes shared with those documents. Two attributes are narrower than their bridge concept and link it with skos:closeMatch in fsct2024.ttl: SBOM Type (the FSCT type set is the SPDX SbomType vocabulary one-to-one), and Copyright Notice (software components only).'

column8: comment

CreationInfo.createdBy (1..*) -> Agent (Person, Organization or SoftwareAgent) names the entity that created the SBOM; the generating tool goes in createdUsing. FSCT 3rd ed. Author Name: the name of the entity that creates the SBOM data for this component. Exact match.
CreationInfo.created (1..1, Core/DateTime: UTC, second resolution) is the date and time the SBOM data was assembled. Exact match.

Software/Sbom.sbomType (0..*, SbomType vocabulary: design, source, build, analyzed, deployed, runtime) is the SPDX adoption of the CISA SBOM types that FSCT defines; the value sets coincide one-to-one, hence exactMatch here while the bridge concept (lifecycle stage in general) is linked with closeMatch.
ElementCollection.rootElement on the Sbom identifies the primary component the SBOM describes (the root of the dependency graph). Exact match.
Complementary path: a Relationship with relationshipType describes from the Sbom to the primary Package; rootElement is the preferred carrier in SPDX 3.x. closeMatch.

A Core/Relationship with relationshipType dependsOn: from = the dependent component (the primary component or an included component), to = the components it depends on; the model requires a LifecycleScopedRelationship for this type (scope: build, runtime, ...). FSCT asks the SBOM to characterise the relationships between the primary component and its included components. Exact match.
FSCT's 'included in' reading: Relationship with relationshipType contains from the containing component to its included components. closeMatch.
Generic: every dependency relationship is a Core/Relationship element with from, to (1..*) and relationshipType. closeMatch at class level.
Element.name (1..1 on Software/Package) carries the name the supplier assigned to the component. Exact match.
Software/Package.packageVersion (0..1) carries the version string the supplier assigned. Exact match. (SPDX 3.1 deprecates it in favour of Core/version on Package.)
Artifact.suppliedBy (0..1) -> Agent is the party that supplied the component. Exact match for the supplying-party reading of the FSCT Supplier Name.

Artifact.originatedBy (0..*) -> Agent is the party the component originally came from. FSCT (like NTIA 2021) defines the supplier as the entity that creates, defines and identifies the component, which for a redistributed component is the originator rather than the supplier; record both when they differ. closeMatch.
Software/Package.packageUrl (0..1, PURL / ECMA-427) is the recommended common, globally unique identifier for a component in SPDX 3.x. Exact match for the primary identifier use.
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe22 (identifier = the CPE 2.2 string). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType cpe23. closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swid (SWID tag id). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType swhid (Software Heritage persistent identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).
ExternalIdentifier with externalIdentifierType gitoid (OmniBOR artifact or input-manifest identifier). closeMatch (one identifier kind).

SoftwareArtifact.contentIdentifier (0..*, anyURI in 3.0.1; a ContentIdentifier object in 3.1): canonical intrinsic identifiers derived from content (OmniBOR gitoid, SWHID). closeMatch for the intrinsic-identifier use.
The element spdxId IRI is globally unique and may serve as an identifier within and across SPDX documents, but does not replace a common external identifier. closeMatch.
Artifact.verifiedUsing (0..*) -> Core/Hash holds the algorithm / hashValue pair that identifies the exact component artifact. closeMatch: the entry point; the two fields are mapped below.
Hash.hashValue (1..1, hexadecimal string) is the digest. narrowMatch (one aspect of the algorithm + digest pair).
Hash.algorithm (1..1, HashAlgorithm vocabulary: sha256, sha512, sha3_256, blake2b512, md5, sha1, ...) is the algorithm. narrowMatch (the other aspect of the pair).

Core/Relationship elements with from, to (1..*), relationshipType (RelationshipType vocabulary: contains, dependsOn, descendantOf, hasDistributionArtifact, ...) and optional completeness characterise how a component relates to the primary component and to other components. Exact match.

Relationship.completeness (0..1, RelationshipCompleteness: complete, incomplete, noAssertion) states whether the listed to-elements are the full set, the carrier of FSCT's known-unknowns statement for a relationship. closeMatch.

Relationship with relationshipType hasConcludedLicense from the Artifact to an AnyLicenseInfo element (LicenseExpression, ListedLicense, CustomLicense, NoAssertionLicense, NoneLicense): the license the SBOM author concludes governs the component, which is the FSCT attribute. Exact match (bridge concept bom:component-concluded-license).
Relationship with relationshipType hasDeclaredLicense carries the license the supplier declared, the usual input to the conclusion. closeMatch.

SimpleLicensing/LicenseExpression.licenseExpression (1..1) on the element reached through the hasConcludedLicense Relationship carries the SPDX license expression string. closeMatch (value field of the relationship target).

Software/SoftwareArtifact.copyrightText (0..1) carries the copyright notice of a Package, File or Snippet. Exact match for software components (FSCT scope); the bridge concept, which also covers non-software elements with no copyright field, is linked with closeMatch.
